Hanqing Zhu1,♠††Work completed when Hanqing Zhu was at UT Austin. This work builds on our prior analysis of RL optimization dynamics (The Path Not Taken) and develops a concrete RL-native optimization stack.    Wenyan Cong1,♠    Zhizhou Sha1    Sagnik Mukherjee2    Xinyuan Song3    David González-Martínez6    Xiaoxia Wu4    Yuandong Tian5    Shiwei Liu6    David Z. 摘要Abstract

具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）正在迅速提高语言模型的推理能力，但将奖励反馈转换为权重空间更新的优化层仍然知之甚少。 基于我们之前的分析Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is rapidly advancing the reasoning capabilities of language models, yet the optimization layer that converts reward feedback into weight-space updates remains poorly understood. Building on our prior analysis[zhu2025path], 我们通过模型的奇异结构来研究这个缺失的层 权重并识别, we study this missing layer through the singular structure of model weights and identify光谱遗传spectral inheritance：RLVR 可以重用基础模型的权重谱，同时通过改变权重谱来获取新的行为 关联的输入和输出奇异帧。 我们进一步确认，学习端点的紧密重建需要两个奇异帧保持适应性：仅在传入的输入和输出范围内重新混合，或保持任一传入子空间固定，留下更多的检查点 无法解释的变化。: RLVR can reuse the base model’s weight spectra while acquiring new behavior through changes in the associated input and output singular frames. We further confirm that close reconstruction of learned endpoints requires both singular frames to remain adaptable: remixing only within the incoming input and output spans, or keeping either incoming subspace fixed, leaves substantially more of the checkpoint change unexplained.

我们将谱继承操作为We operationalize spectral inheritance as等光谱优化 (ISO)Isospectral Optimization (ISO)，一个 RLVR 原生的固定频谱优化框架，具有互补的离线和在线实例化。, an RLVR-native, fixed-spectrum optimization framework with complementary offline and online instantiations.离线Offline, ISO合并ISO-Merger将共享基础专家的框架更改合并到单个固定频谱模型中，不需要合并后数据、推出、梯度更新或策略蒸馏（OPD）。 它恢复互补的专业能力并实现最强的综合性能 在比较的无数据合并方法中。combines the frame changes of shared-base specialists into a single fixed-spectrum model, requiring no post-merge data, rollouts, gradient updates, or on-policy distillation (OPD). It recovers complementary specialist capabilities and achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the compared data-free merging methods.在线Online, ISO优化器ISO-Optimizer应用选定的基本优化器， 包括 AdamW 和 Muon，到框架变量，同时保留基础光谱 固定。跨越从 1.5B 到 8B 参数的推理和编码任务， ISO-Optimizer 提高了报告运行的准确性并达到匹配的分数 训练步骤大大减少。开applies a chosen base optimizer, including AdamW and Muon, to the frame variables while keeping the base spectra fixed. Across reasoning and coding tasks ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, ISO-Optimizer improves accuracy in the reported runs and reaches matched scores with substantially fewer training steps. OnQwen3-8B-底座Qwen3-8B-Base, 亚当W 达到总准确度, AdamW reaches an aggregate accuracy of0.4950.495之后after270270训练步骤。 ISO-AdamW 仅在training steps. ISO-AdamW reaches the same accuracy after only100100训练步骤和改进 进一步到training steps and improves further to0.5090.509 at 210210训练步骤。 ISO 共同为 RLVR 缺失的优化层提供了具体的答案： 而不是继承预训练优化批发，设计 围绕奖励驱动适应结构的后培训：training steps. Together, ISO offers a concrete answer to RLVR’s missing optimization layer: rather than inheriting pre-training optimization wholesale, design post-training around the structure of reward-driven adaptation:继承频谱，优化帧inherit the spectrum, optimize the frames.

1 简介Introduction

具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为主要研究方向 现代推理模型的缩放轴Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a major scaling axis for modern reasoning models[grok2025]，进展迅速 跨数据和环境, with rapid progress across data and environments[scale2026rlenvironments]、学习 目标, learning objectives[deepseek_r1, yu2025dapo, hu2025reinforce++, tajwar2026maximum], 和系统, and systems[slime_github, sheng2025hybridflow]。 然而，优化器和参数化将奖励反馈转化为 尽管重量空间运动在很大程度上仍然继承自预训练 最近专门为此设计的优化器激增 政权. Yet the optimizers and parameterizations that translate reward feedback into weight-space motion remain largely inherited from pre-training, despite the recent proliferation of optimizers designed specifically for that regime[adamw, liu2025muon, zhu2025apollo, wen2025fantastic]。 这种默认设置还不是很自然：预训练是从密集学习中学习的 代币级别的监管，而 RLVR 使用已经有能力的策略来调整 结果级奖励相对稀疏。. This default is not yet obviously natural: pre-training learns from dense token-level supervision, whereas RLVR adapts an already capable policy using comparatively sparse outcome-level rewards.

我们研究了这个缺失的优化层并揭示了两者之间的分离We study this missing optimization layer and uncover a separation betweenRLVR 重用了什么以及它改变了什么what RLVR reuses and what it changes。我们称这种现象为. We call this phenomenon光谱遗传spectral inheritance: RLVR 可以重用基础模型的权重谱，同时通过更改相关的输入和输出奇异帧来获取新的行为RLVR can reuse the base model’s weight spectra while acquiring new behavior by changing the associated input and output singular frames.

现有帐户并未公开这种分离，但它们确实表明 RLVR 在结构上不同于预训练和监督微调 （SFT）。在政策层面，RLVR通过reverse-KL进行了描述， KL-近端视图Existing accounts do not expose this separation, but they do suggest that RLVR differs structurally from pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). At the policy level, RLVR has been described through reverse-KL and KL-proximal views[zhu2025path, shenfeld2025rl]。在参数层面， 据报道，其欧几里得更新是稀疏且偏离原则的， 从初始化的独立运行中强烈重叠的足迹 相同基础型号. At the parameter level, its Euclidean updates have been reported to be sparse and off-principal, with strongly overlapping footprints across independent runs initialized from the same base model[mukherjee2025reinforcement, zhu2025path]。这些发现 识别 RLVR 中的独特结构，但不能识别坐标系 将重用的内容与更改的内容分开。. These findings identify distinctive structure in RLVR, but not a coordinate system that separates what is reused from what changes.

观察：光谱保持。Observation: spectra stay.

受到我们之前对有限光谱漂移的观察的启发 右室VRMotivated by our prior observation of limited spectral drift in RLVR[zhu2025path]，我们从欧几里德权重坐标移动到 光谱视图。对于每个权重矩阵，写, we move from Euclidean weight coordinates to a spectral view. For each weight matrix, writeWt=Ut​Σt​Vt⊤W_{t}=U_{t}\Sigma_{t}V_{t}^{\top}: Σt\Sigma_{t}指定单数的尺度 模式，同时specifies the scales of the singular modes, while(Ut,Vt)(U_{t},V_{t})指定它们的输出和输入方向。在此处研究的无约束 RLVR 运行中，学习到的检查点仍然接近 其基本权重的固定谱系列，我们称之为的模式specify their output and input directions. Across the unconstrained RLVR runs studied here, the learned checkpoints remain close to the fixed-spectrum families of their base weights, a pattern we call近等光谱near-isospectrality。 因为无约束 RLVR 优化不施加谱约束，所以我们进一步问 这种接近度是否反映了真正的优化偏好。一个 尺寸感知校准没有发现强烈的额外偏好 频谱保持运动超出了高维单独预测的范围， 尽管与 SFT 的对比仍然很明显。 因此，校准改进了而不是削弱了观测结果：RLVR 仍然接近等光谱，但仅靠接近度并不能建立内在的优化偏好。这留下了更多 随之而来的功能问题：. Because unconstrained RLVR optimization imposes no spectral constraint, we further ask whether this proximity reflects a genuine optimization preference. A dimension-aware calibration finds no strong additional preference for spectrum-preserving motion beyond what high dimensionality alone predicts, although the contrast with SFT remains pronounced. The calibration therefore refines rather than weakens the observation: RLVR remains near-isospectral, but proximity alone does not establish an intrinsic optimization preference. This leaves the more consequential functional question:是所发生的小光谱变化所必需的 行为？are the small spectral changes that do occur necessary for the acquired behavior?

功能规律：光谱遗传。Functional regularity: spectral inheritance.

接下来我们测试一个比光谱邻近度更强的问题： 是不受约束的 RLVR 功能产生的微小光谱变化 有必要吗？ 恢复 RLVR 检查点的基础光谱，同时保留其学到的知识 框架，保留大部分获得的收益。 更严格地说，在整个训练过程中保持基础光谱固定， 仅更新相关帧仍然支持强大的 RLVR 学习。 相反，仅受限频谱控制会更新奇异值 冻结基础框架时的值仅产生有限的改进。We next test a stronger question than spectral proximity: are the small spectral changes produced by unconstrained RLVR functionally necessary? Restoring the base spectra of RLVR checkpoints, while retaining their learned frames, preserves most acquired gains. More stringently, keeping the base spectra fixed throughout training and updating only the associated frames still supports strong RLVR learning. Conversely, a restricted spectrum-only control, which updates the singular values while freezing the base frames, yields only limited improvement.

我们将这种功能重用称为We refer to this functional reuse as光谱遗传spectral inheritance: RLVR 可以重用基础模型的权重谱，而不是 必须重写它们才能获得新功能RLVR can reuse the base model’s weight spectra rather than having to rewrite them to acquire new capabilities.

结构：两个框架都必须保持适应性。Structure: both frames must remain adaptable.

谱继承标识哪些变量可以重用，但不能标识哪些变量必须保持适应性。学习的端点是否可以通过更简单的转换来解释，即仅在传入的输入和输出范围内重新混合模型，或者保留一个传入的奇异子空间，同时只允许另一侧更改？我们发现两种选择都留下了 与保留传入频谱同时允许两个奇异帧适应相比，检查点变化的大部分无法解释。 因此，在测试的结构选择中，频谱可以保持固定，但两个框架必须保持适应性。相同的光谱继承和两帧适应性模式在具有不同特征的连续 RL 阶段中重复出现 目标。Spectral inheritance identifies what can be reused, but not which variables must remain adaptable. Could the learned endpoint instead be explained by a simpler transformation that either remixes the model only within the incoming input and output spans, or retains one incoming singular subspace while allowing only the other side to change? We find that both alternatives leave a substantially larger portion of the checkpoint change unexplained than retaining the incoming spectrum while allowing both singular frames to adapt. Thus, among the structural choices tested, the spectrum can remain fixed, but both frames must remain adaptable. The same spectral-inheritance and two-frame-adaptability pattern recurs across sequential RL stages with distinct objectives.

ISO：RLVR 的等谱优化。ISO: Isospectral Optimization for RLVR.

这些发现提出了一个简单的设计原则：These findings suggest a simple design principle:继承频谱，优化帧inherit the spectrum, optimize the frames。 我们通过以下方式实施这一原则. We operationalize this principle through等谱优化 (ISO)Isospectral Optimization (ISO)，一个代表培训后变化的框架 基本权重的固定频谱族，同时保持两个奇异帧 适应性强。 ISO 不是单一的数值优化器；这是 RLVR 原生优化 与跨越 RLVR 工作流程的两个互补实例进行堆栈： ISO 合并仅用于共享基础专家的检查点组合 用于在线学习的 ISO-Optimizer，使用选定的基础优化器（例如 AdamW） 或介子。, a framework that represents post-training change within the fixed-spectrum families of the base weights while keeping both singular frames adaptable. ISO is not a single numerical optimizer; it is an RLVR-native optimization stack with two complementary instantiations spanning the RLVR workflow: ISO-Merger for checkpoint-only composition of shared-base specialists and ISO-Optimizer for online learning with a chosen base optimizer such as AdamW or Muon.

  • 离线：ISO 合并。Offline: ISO-Merger.模块化 RLVR 工作流程可在共享基础上培训领域专家 通常通过额外的政策蒸馏来整合它们 舞台A modular RLVR workflow trains domain specialists from a shared base and later consolidates them, often through an additional on-policy distillation stage[lu2025onpolicydistillation, zeng2026glm]。 ISO-Merger 直接整合了他们的专家 检查站。 在光谱继承的指导下，它重用共享的基础光谱并直接 将专家的奇异帧变化组合成单个固定频谱 模型。 无需合并后数据、额外的推出生成、梯度更新或蒸馏， ISO 合并恢复了互补的专业能力并实现了 比较无数据方法中最强的总体性能。. ISO-Merger instead consolidates the specialists directly from their checkpoints. Guided by spectral inheritance, it reuses the shared base spectra and directly combines the experts’ singular-frame changes into a single fixed-spectrum model. Without post-merge data, additional rollout generation, gradient updates, or distillation, ISO-Merger recovers complementary specialist capabilities and achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the compared data-free methods.

    在线：ISO-Optimizer。Online: ISO-Optimizer.ISO-Optimizer 在 RLVR 训练期间应用相同的原理。给定一个 传统的基础优化器，例如 AdamW 或 Muon，它引导奖励反馈 进入相应固定频谱族内的重量空间运动， 更新奇异帧变量，同时保持基本光谱固定。 跨推理和编码设置以及多个模型尺度，ISO-Optimizer 提高最终准确性并以更少的训练步骤达到匹配的准确性 比相应的权重空间优化器。ISO-Optimizer applies the same principle during RLVR training. Given a conventional base optimizer such as AdamW or Muon, it channels reward feedback into weight-space motion within the corresponding fixed-spectrum families, updating the singular-frame variables while keeping the base spectra fixed. Across reasoning and coding settings and multiple model scales, ISO-Optimizer improves final accuracy and reaches matched accuracy in fewer training steps than the corresponding weight-space optimizers.

2 光谱保持：从近同光谱到光谱继承Spectra Stay: From Near-Isospectrality to Spectral Inheritance

从稀疏欧几里得运动到谱结构。From sparse Euclidean motion to spectral structure.

最近的分析表明，RLVR 与预训练和 SFT 的不同之处在于 重量空间运动。在政策层面，RLVR 被描述为 保守的，当前的 KL-近端改进 政策Recent analyses suggest that RLVR differs from pre-training and SFT in its weight-space motion. At the policy level, RLVR has been described as a conservative, KL-proximal improvement of the current policy[wu2025invisible, shenfeld2025rl, zhu2025path]。在参数处 水平，据报道其欧几里得更新是稀疏且偏离原则的， 从同一基础初始化的运行之间具有强烈重叠的模式 模型. At the parameter level, its Euclidean updates have been reported to be sparse and off-principal, with strongly overlapping patterns across runs initialized from the same base model[mukherjee2025reinforcement, zhu2025path]。这就提出了一个难题： 明显稀疏和偏离原则的体重会带来巨大的行为收益 运动。. This raises a puzzle: large behavioral gains arise from apparently sparse and off-principal weight motion.

这些规律表明 RLVR 运动是结构化的，但原始的欧几里得运动 坐标并不能揭示什么被重用以及什么被重写。建立在我们的 RLVR 中有限光谱漂移的先前观察These regularities suggest that RLVR motion is structured, but raw Euclidean coordinates do not reveal what is reused and what is rewritten. Building on our prior observation of limited spectral drift in RLVR[zhu2025path]，我们问 两个问题。首先，观察到的光谱接近度是否反映了真实的光谱 偏好频谱保留运动？尺寸感知校准发现 没有超出环境维度已经预测的强烈偏好。 其次，微小的光谱变化在功能上仍然是必要的吗？我们 通过恢复基本光谱的补充干预措施来测试这一点 训练后或在整个训练过程中保持固定。我们称得到的结果为 功能重用, we ask two questions. First, does the observed spectral proximity reflect a genuine preference for spectrum-preserving motion? A dimension-aware calibration finds no strong preference beyond what ambient dimensionality already predicts. Second, are the small spectral changes that remain functionally necessary? We test this through complementary interventions that restore the base spectra after training or keep them fixed throughout training. We call the resulting functional reuse光谱遗传spectral inheritance。部分. 2.2 光谱继承：重用基础模型的光谱Spectral Inheritance: Reusing the Base Model’s Spectrum

尺寸校准改变了对初始值的解释 观察而不推翻它。 RLVR 仍接近The dimensional calibration changes the interpretation of the initial observation without overturning it. RLVR remains close toℱ​(W0)\mathcal{F}(W_{0})，但仅靠这种接近并不能揭示出强烈的偏好 用于频谱保护更新。关键的功能问题是 获得的行为需要确实发生的微小光谱变化。, but this proximity alone does not reveal a strong preference for spectrum-preserving updates. The key functional question is whether the small spectral changes that do occur are needed for the acquired behavior.

我们通过两种互补的干预措施来解决这个问题。首先，我们 在无约束的 RLVR 后恢复基础频谱，同时保留学习到的 帧，测试端点是否仍然需要其获取的光谱 改变。其次，我们在整个训练、测试过程中保持基本频谱固定 是否可以在根本不允许这种变化的情况下获得强劲的收益。We address this question through two complementary interventions. First, we restore the base spectrum after unconstrained RLVR while retaining the learned frames, testing whether the endpoint still requires its acquired spectral change. Second, we keep the base spectrum fixed throughout training, testing whether strong gains can be acquired without allowing that change at all.

4 从光谱继承到等光谱优化 (ISO)From Spectral Inheritance to Isospectral Optimization (ISO)

部分Sections2–3确定互补的 算法设计的约束。部分identify complementary constraints for algorithm design. Section2表明 基础光谱可以重复使用，同时保留和获取 RLVR 增益。 部分shows that the base spectra can be reused while RLVR gains are retained and acquired. Section3然后表明两个奇异框架必须保持适应性。then shows that both singular frames must remain adaptable.

我们将这种分离用作归纳偏差，而不是声称 无约束 RLVR 遵循精确的固定频谱更新定律。动机是 这个证据，我们介绍We use this separation as an inductive bias rather than as a claim that unconstrained RLVR follows an exact fixed-spectrum update law. Motivated by this evidence, we introduce等谱优化Isospectral Optimization（ISO），一个 RLVR 原生优化堆栈，可重用基础光谱并将两个奇异帧公开为离线专家合成和在线 RLVR 训练的自适应坐标。(ISO), an RLVR-native optimization stack that reuses the base spectra and exposes both singular frames as adaptable coordinates for offline expert composition and online RLVR training.

ISO 是一个框架而不是单个优化器。一样的 固定频谱帧参数化支持两个互补阶段 RLVR 工作流程。线下 ISO 合并整合了共享基础强化学习专家 直接从他们的检查点，没有合并后数据，额外的推出， 梯度更新，或策略蒸馏阶段。在线 ISO 优化器 将传统的基础优化器（例如 AdamW 或 Muon）应用于框架 变量ISO is a framework rather than a single optimizer. The same fixed-spectrum frame parameterization supports two complementary stages of the RLVR workflow. Offline, ISO-Merger consolidates shared-base RL specialists directly from their checkpoints, without post-merge data, additional rollouts, gradient updates, or an on-policy distillation stage. Online, ISO-Optimizer applies a conventional base optimizer, such as AdamW or Muon, to the frame variables(U,V)(U,V)在 RLVR 训练期间。两个实例都重用基础 合成或优化后的频谱和恢复帧的可行性。during RLVR training. Both instantiations reuse the base spectrum and restore frame feasibility after composition or optimization.

4.2 ISO 合并：无需部署即可合并 RL 专家ISO-Merger: Merging RL Experts Without Rollouts

共享库 RL 专家的无数据组成。Data-free composition of shared-base RL experts.

跨异构域训练单一 RLVR 策略的成本可能很高 且不稳定。模块化的替代方案是培训多名专家 共享基础，然后将其能力整合为单一政策。 一种常见的整合策略是额外的策略内蒸馏 由在线推广推动的阶段Training a single RLVR policy across heterogeneous domains can be expensive and unstable. A modular alternative is to train several specialists from a shared base and then consolidate their capabilities into a single policy. One common consolidation strategy is an additional on-policy distillation stage driven by online rollouts[lu2025onpolicydistillation, zeng2026glm]。 相反，ISO-Merger 解决了严格的仅检查点设置：它需要 没有合并后数据、推出生成、梯度更新或蒸馏。它 追求与政策蒸馏相同的广泛目标：恢复 在单一政策中补充专业能力。. ISO-Merger instead addresses the strictly checkpoint-only setting: it requires no post-merge data, rollout generation, gradient updates, or distillation. It pursues the same broad objective as on-policy distillation: recovering complementary specialist capabilities in a single policy.

我们专注于从同一基地检查站接受培训的专家，每个 针对特定领域或能力的专家。合并已经是通才 受过广泛、实质上重叠的混合训练的政策构成了 我们在这里不研究的不同设置。We focus on specialists trained from the same base checkpoint, with each expert targeting a distinct domain or capability. Merging already-generalist policies trained on broad, substantially overlapping mixtures constitutes a different setting that we do not study here.

我们将相同的构造应用于二维嵌入和非嵌入 矩阵。一维参数，例如归一化尺度和 偏差是使用简单平均值组成的。 ISO 合并 在共享固定频谱坐标中执行仅检查点合成， 不需要合并后数据、推出、梯度更新或蒸馏。 完整的算法细节在 附录We apply the same construction to two-dimensional embedding and unembedding matrices. One-dimensional parameters, such as normalization scales and biases, are composed using a simple average. ISO-Merger thus performs checkpoint-only composition in shared fixed-spectrum coordinates, requiring no post-merge data, rollouts, gradient updates, or distillation. Full algorithmic details are provided in AppendixE.

After every retraction, the reconstructed weight remains in the strictly more constrained fixed-spectrum familyℱ​(W0)\mathcal{F}(W_{0})。因此，观察到的收益不能归因于更大的 可行的模型类，尽管因子空间参数化和优化器 动力学也是该方法的一部分。 直接在权重空间中制定的替代频谱保护优化器 也是可能的。系统地比较此类配方 因子空间 ISO 留给未来的工作。. Thus, the observed gains cannot be attributed to a larger feasible model class, although the factor-space parameterization and optimizer dynamics are also part of the method. Alternative spectrum-preserving optimizers formulated directly in weight space are also possible. Systematically comparing such formulations with factor-space ISO is left to future work.

5 实验Experiments

我们在对应于其两种算法的两种设置中评估 ISO 实例化。首先，我们测试ISO-Merger是否可以组成RLVR专家 无需额外部署，同时保留其专业能力， 追求类似于在政策蒸馏的目标。第二，我们 测试 ISO-Optimizer 应用于基础时是否可以提高 RLVR 收敛性 优化器，例如 AdamW 和 Muon。We evaluate ISO in two settings corresponding to its two algorithmic instantiations. First, we test whether ISO-Merger can compose RLVR experts without additional rollouts while preserving their specialist capabilities, pursuing an objective similar to that of on-policy distillation. Second, we test whether ISO-Optimizer improves RLVR convergence when applied to base optimizers such as AdamW and Muon.

Figure10将此成本描述为 代表profiles this cost on a representativeQwen3-4B-底座Qwen3-4B-BaseRLVR 使用 8K 上下文窗口运行。 相对于 AdamW，ISO 将优化器更新时间增加了大约RLVR run with an 8K context window. Relative to AdamW, ISO increases the optimizer-update time by approximately8686每步秒数，但这种增加仅占大约seconds per step, but this increase accounts for only about7%7\%的 此设置中的端到端 RL 步长时间。端到端运行时间仍然存在 由其他部分（例如，推出生成）主导，而不是由优化器更新主导。的 总步骤时间的差异也会增加，因为 ISO 产生更长的时间 响应，从而增加推出延迟。此成本概况不同于 预训练，其中优化器计算直接位于 每一步的关键路径。 RLVR 包括更长的一代 阶段，提供额外的机会来潜在地摊销间接费用或 将参与者端计算与推出生成重叠，尤其是在现代 异步强化学习系统。of the end-to-end RL step time in this setting. The end-to-end runtime remains dominated by other parts, e.g., rollout generation, rather than by the optimizer update. The difference in total step time also grows because ISO produces longer responses, thereby increasing rollout latency. This cost profile differs from that of pre-training, where optimizer computation lies directly on the critical path of each step. RLVR includes a substantially longer generation phase, providing additional opportunities to potentially amortize the overhead or overlap actor-side computation with rollout generation, especially in modern asynchronous RL systems.

6 相关工作Related Work

RLVR 动力学和优化。RLVR dynamics and optimization.

RLVR 的大部分进步都集中在数据和环境上， 学习 目标或系统基础设施。 相比之下，优化层将奖励反馈转化为 参数空间运动仍然相对未得到充分探索，并且通常 继承自预训练，包括优化器的选择和 参数化。 最近的分析已经开始将 RLVR 与预训练区分开来 在策略和参数层面进行监督微调。 在政策层面，RLVR 通过 KL-proximal 和 保守的政策改进观点。在参数层面，其更新 据报道，这些内容稀疏、偏离原则，并且在各个方面都具有强烈的共享性。 从同一源运行初始化 模型Most advances in RLVR have focused on data and environments, learning objectives, or systems infrastructure. By contrast, the optimization layer that translates reward feedback into parameter-space motion remains comparatively underexplored and is typically inherited from pre-training, including the choice of optimizer and parameterization. Recent analyses have begun to distinguish RLVR from pre-training and supervised fine-tuning at both the policy and parameter levels. At the policy level, RLVR has been characterized through KL-proximal and conservative policy-improvement views. At the parameter level, its updates have been reported to be sparse, off-principal, and strongly shared across runs initialized from the same source model[wu2025invisible, shenfeld2025rl, mukherjee2025reinforcement, zhu2025path]。 基于我们之前对有限光谱漂移的观察 右室VR. Building on our prior observation of limited spectral drift in RLVR[zhu2025path]，我们形式化并测试, we formalize and test光谱遗传spectral inheritance: 的 基本模型的奇异值谱可以保持功能上的可重用性，而 相关的输入和输出帧进行调整。 然后我们利用这个原理来指导 RLVR 优化算法设计。: the base model’s singular-value spectra can remain functionally reusable while the associated input and output frames adapt. We then use this principle to guide RLVR optimization algorithm design.

矩阵几何优化和约束参数化。Matrix-geometric optimization and constrained parameterizations.

越来越多的工作将矩阵值参数和更新视为 结构化对象而不是扁平化的欧几里得向量。这些方法 作用于不同的对象并施加不同形式的结构。 Muon 正交化矩阵值动量更新，而 DION 则发展 这种正交归一化的可扩展分布式近似 更新A growing line of work treats matrix-valued parameters and updates as structured objects rather than as flattened Euclidean vectors. These methods act on different objects and impose different forms of structure. Muon orthogonalizes matrix-valued momentum updates, while DION develops scalable distributed approximations to such orthonormalized updates[liu2025muon, ahn2025dion]。 Hyperball 约束权重矩阵和优化器的 Frobenius 范数 更新，使相对角度步长明确而不是控制 它间接通过重量衰减. Hyperball constrains the Frobenius norms of both weight matrices and optimizer updates, making the relative angular step size explicit rather than controlling it indirectly through weight decay[wen2025fantastic]。 模块化流形观点提倡共同设计特定模块 约束和更新规范，包括 Stiefel 约束权重和 Muon 的流形版本. The Modular Manifolds perspective advocates co-designing module-specific constraints and update norms, including Stiefel-constrained weights and a manifold version of Muon[bernstein2025manifolds]。 POET 和 POET-X 通过两侧保留重量谱 正交等价重新参数化，重点是稳定和 高效的法学硕士培训. POET and POET-X preserve weight spectra through two-sided orthogonal-equivalence reparameterizations, with an emphasis on stable and efficient LLM training[qiu2026reparameterized, qiu2026poet]。 相关结构也已用于参数有效的自适应： Spectral Adapter 修改领先的光谱子空间，而 StelLA 学习 低秩的正交输入和输出子空间 适配器. Related structure has also been used for parameter-efficient adaptation: Spectral Adapter modifies a leading spectral subspace, while StelLA learns orthonormal input and output subspaces for a low-rank adapter[zhang2024spectral, li2026stella].

独立并发工作 PionAn independent concurrent work Pion[shi2026pion]还可以保持体重 通过左、右正交等价变换的光谱。 Pion 被引入作为通用 LLM 的频谱保留优化器 训练，并进一步使其结构适应 RLVR，其动机 明确地利用了我们之前的光谱观察 工作also preserves weight spectra through left and right orthogonal-equivalence transformations. Pion is introduced as a spectrum-preserving optimizer for general LLM training, and further adapts its construction to RLVR, where its motivation explicitly draws on the spectral observation from our earlier work[zhu2025path]。 因此，与 ISO 的重叠在在线 RLVR 优化中最为直接。 然而，这两种方法在结构和范围上都有所不同。 Pion 通过专用的李代数直接更新每个权重矩阵 更新规则，加上它自己的尺度控制、动量设计，以及 近似指数图。 ISO 相反修复了基础频谱，暴露了相关的奇异帧 作为优化变量，并应用选定的基本优化器，包括 AdamW 或 Muon，对这些变量，然后撤回。 更根本的是，Pion 从作为优化器的频谱保存开始 一般法学硕士培训的设计原则，其构建动机是 预训练稳定性、尺度控制和正交等效几何。 ISO 从 RLVR 特定的经验和功能特征开始： 我们确定. The overlap with ISO is therefore most direct in online RLVR optimization. The two approaches nevertheless differ in both construction and scope. Pion updates each weight matrix directly through a dedicated Lie-algebra update rule, together with its own scale control, momentum design, and approximate exponential map. ISO instead fixes the base spectrum, exposes the associated singular frames as optimization variables, and applies a chosen base optimizer, including AdamW or Muon, to those variables, followed by retraction. More fundamentally, Pion begins from spectrum preservation as an optimizer design principle for general LLM training, with its construction motivated by pre-training stability, scale control, and orthogonal-equivalence geometry. ISO begins from an RLVR-specific empirical and functional characterization: we identify光谱遗传spectral inheritance，挑战原始近等光谱性 通过维度感知校准，并通过测试基谱重用 功能干预和连续强化学习阶段。 然后，我们将这一证据推广到 RLVR 原生优化框架中，而不是 比单个优化器。 它的在线实例化改变了传统的基础优化器，同时它的 离线实例化提供了一种仅检查点的组合方法 共享基础强化学习专家。, challenge raw near-isospectrality through dimension-aware calibration, and test base-spectrum reuse through functional interventions and sequential RL stages. We then promote this evidence to an RLVR-native optimization framework rather than a single optimizer. Its online instantiation transforms conventional base optimizers, while its offline instantiation provides a checkpoint-only method for composing shared-base RL experts.

从矩阵几何先验到 RLVR 原生后训练堆栈。From matrix-geometric priors to an RLVR-native post-training stack.

总而言之，这些作品展示了矩阵几何的价值 优化中的结构。 我们的贡献并不是首次使用正交性、流形或谱 限制。 相反，ISO 遵循专为 RLVR 量身定制的从证据到设计的路线。 我们首先研究无约束的 RLVR 并通过维度感知来展示 校准，原始的近等光谱本身并没有歧视性。 然后我们测试学习到的光谱变化在功能上是否必要， 基础频谱是否可以在整个学习过程中保持固定，以及如何 剩余的检查点变化被组织在相关的单一帧中。 相同的学习模式在顺序强化学习中重复出现 具有明确目标的阶段。 这些分析共同确定了Taken together, these works demonstrate the value of matrix-geometric structure in optimization. Our contribution is not the first use of orthogonality, manifolds, or spectral constraints. Rather, ISO follows an evidence-to-design route tailored to RLVR. We begin by studying unconstrained RLVR and show, through dimension-aware calibration, that raw near-isospectrality alone is not discriminative. We then test whether the learned spectral changes are functionally necessary, whether the base spectrum can remain fixed throughout learning, and how the remaining checkpoint change is organized in the associated singular frames. The same learning pattern recurs across sequential RL stages with distinct objectives. Together, these analyses establish光谱遗传spectral inheritance：RLVR可以重复使用 源模型的权重谱，同时通过变化获得新的行为 在相关的输入和输出奇异帧中。 ISO 促进了这种经验上和功能上支持的规律性 对显式 RLVR 归纳偏差的描述性观察。: RLVR can reuse the source model’s weight spectra while acquiring new behavior through changes in the associated input and output singular frames. ISO promotes this empirically and functionally supported regularity from a descriptive observation to an explicit RLVR inductive bias.

ISO 使用这种归纳偏差来重新设计 RLVR 训练后堆栈 共同的固定频谱原则。 而不是将这个想法与特定的优化器或一个单一的框架联系起来 重新参数化，ISO 将谱继承视为可重用接口 跨越培训后的不同阶段。 在在线 RLVR 期间，它控制奖励驱动的更新的表示方式和 在继承光谱下执行。 训练后，它提供了一个共享坐标系来巩固 独立训练的强化学习专家，无需额外的推广或蒸馏。 因此，ISO-Optimizer 和 ISO-Merger 并不是两种不相关的算法，而是 同一堆栈级设计的两个互补实现，跨越在线 政策学习和线下专家整合。 这里研究的奇异框架结构是一种数值实现 这个原则而不是ISO本身的定义。 替代执行机制以及同一机制中的进一步应用 框架，包括几何感知适配器初始化、适配器训练、 和适配器组成，保持开放方向。ISO uses this inductive bias to redesign the RLVR post-training stack around a common fixed-spectrum principle. Rather than tying the idea to a particular optimizer or to one singular-frame reparameterization, ISO treats spectral inheritance as a reusable interface across different stages of post-training. During online RLVR, it governs how reward-driven updates are represented and executed under the inherited spectra. After training, it provides a shared coordinate system for consolidating independently trained RL experts without additional rollouts or distillation. ISO-Optimizer and ISO-Merger are therefore not two unrelated algorithms, but two complementary realizations of the same stack-level design, spanning online policy learning and offline expert consolidation. The singular-frame construction studied here is one numerical realization of this principle rather than the definition of ISO itself. Alternative enforcement mechanisms and further applications within the same framework, including geometry-aware adapter initialization, adapter training, and adapter composition, remain open directions.

总之，ISO 提供了证据到堆栈设计： 它从 RLVR 自身动态中识别光谱继承，验证其 功能相关性，并将其转化为通用的优化原则 涵盖线上政策学习和线下专家整合。In summary, ISO contributes an evidence-to-stack design: it identifies spectral inheritance from RLVR’s own dynamics, validates its functional relevance, and turns it into a common optimization principle spanning online policy learning and offline expert consolidation.

几何感知模型合并。Geometry-aware model merging.

大多数免训练合并方法结合了欧几里得任务向量， 任务算术、TIES 和 TSV-Merge 等技术可减少干扰 通过符号解析或低秩 结构Most training-free merging methods combine Euclidean task vectors, with techniques such as Task Arithmetic, TIES, and TSV-Merge reducing interference through sign resolution or low-rank structure[ta, ties, tsv]。 OrthoMerge 相反，将正交微调变换合并到 Lie 中 代数并通过分离正交扩展到一般微调模型 和残余成分. OrthoMerge instead merges orthogonal fine-tuning transformations in a Lie algebra and extends to generally fine-tuned models by separating orthogonal and residual components[yang2026orthogonal]。 ISO-Merger 专门针对共享基础 RL 专家：它投影每个专家 到共享基础谱的几何形状，表示其框架位移 在公共基锚定 Stiefel 切线空间中，并执行仅检查点合成 无需合并后提示、部署、教师查询或优化。. ISO-Merger is specialized to shared-base RL experts: it projects each expert to the geometry of the shared base spectrum, represents its frame displacement in a common base-anchored Stiefel tangent space, and performs checkpoint-only composition without post-merge prompts, rollouts, teacher queries, or optimization.

7 结论Conclusion

我们确定We identify光谱遗传spectral inheritance作为 RLVR 中的重复结构： 基本模型的权重谱在功能上保持可重用性，同时新的行为 是通过相关奇异帧的变化获得的。正在恢复 训练后的基础光谱保留了大部分获得的性能，并保持 在整个训练过程中固定的它们仍然支持强大的推理和编码 收益。在测试的结构限制中，更简单的子空间重新混合和 片面的转换留下了更多的检查点变化 无法解释，表明两个框架必须保持适应性。这个图案 也会在具有不同目标的连续强化学习阶段中重复出现。as a recurring structure in RLVR: the base model’s weight spectra remain functionally reusable while new behavior is acquired through changes in the associated singular frames. Restoring the base spectra after training preserves most acquired performance, and keeping them fixed throughout training still supports strong reasoning and coding gains. Among the structural restrictions tested, simpler subspace-remixing and one-sided transformations leave substantially more of the checkpoint change unexplained, indicating that both frames must remain adaptable. This pattern also recurs across sequential RL stages with distinct objectives.

在此分离的基础上，我们引入了等谱优化 (ISO)。 ISO-Merger 由共享基础 RL 专家组成，无需合并后数据、部署、 梯度更新，或蒸馏，实现最强的聚合 比较无数据方法的性能。 ISO 优化器适用 传统的基础优化器在固定基础光谱下对框架变量进行优化， 提高聚合精度并以更少的时间达到匹配的精度 训练步骤，包括Building on this separation, we introduce Isospectral Optimization (ISO). ISO-Merger composes shared-base RL experts without post-merge data, rollouts, gradient updates, or distillation, achieving the strongest aggregate performance among the compared data-free methods. ISO-Optimizer applies conventional base optimizers to the frame variables under fixed base spectra, improving aggregate accuracy and reaching matched accuracy in fewer training steps, including2.7×2.7\timesQwen3-8B-Base 上的步骤更少。 总之，这些结果将 RL 之前学习到的谱结构确定为 用于训练后可重复使用的基质：fewer steps on Qwen3-8B-Base. Together, these results identify the spectral structure learned before RL as a reusable substrate for post-training:RLVR可以继承频谱并 了解它的作用RLVR can inherit the spectrum and learn how it acts.

附录AAppendix A定性索引对齐检查Qualitative Index-Alignment Check

为什么需要进行此项检查。Why this check is needed.

正文避免使用单独的奇异向量恒等式作为形式 证据，因为 SVD 基数在符号翻转和旋转下依赖于规范 在近简并奇异值簇内。尽管如此，因为我们的 频谱恢复干预通过秩索引对奇异值进行配对，很有用 验证 RLVR 运行中的排名指数跟踪是否质量稳定 我们分析。The main text avoids using individual singular-vector identities as formal evidence, since SVD bases are gauge-dependent under sign flips and rotations inside near-degenerate singular-value clusters. Nevertheless, because our spectrum-restoration intervention pairs singular values by rank index, it is useful to verify whether rank-index tracking is qualitatively stable in the RLVR runs we analyze.

秩索引奇异向量旋转。Rank-index singular-vector rotations.

对于每一层，我们计算排名索引配对之间的主角 来自基础模型和训练后检查点的奇异方向，之后 标准符号对齐。这些图只能被解释为定性的 健全性检查。正式的框架适应性结论 部分For each layer, we compute the principal angle between rank-index paired singular directions from the base model and the post-training checkpoint, after standard sign alignment. These plots should be interpreted only as qualitative sanity checks. The formal frame-adaptability conclusions in Section3使用基于投影仪的重建和 无法解释的更新比率。use projector-based reconstructions and unexplained-update ratios.

人物Figures11和and12提供一个定性的 RLVR 和 SFT 的对比。在 RLVR 下，秩索引配对奇异方向 旋转温和平稳，表明频谱恢复干预 不受大的索引不匹配的影响。在 SFT 下，许多匹配 方向变得几乎正交，表明排名索引跟踪非常重要 不太稳定。我们强调这些图不用作正式证据 奇异子空间运动。主要的诊断证据是规范不变的 投影仪和重建分析部分provide a qualitative contrast between RLVR and SFT. Under RLVR, rank-index paired singular directions rotate mildly and smoothly, suggesting that the spectrum-restoration intervention is not dominated by large index-wise mismatch. Under SFT, many matched directions become nearly orthogonal, indicating that rank-index tracking is much less stable. We emphasize that these plots are not used as formal evidence for singular-subspace motion. The main diagnostic evidence is the gauge-invariant projector and reconstruction analysis in Section3.

备注 B.7Remark B.7 （重构测试解读）(Interpretation of the reconstruction test).

重建类具有不同的维度，因此我们不解释 它们的残差排序作为复杂性归一化模型选择结果。 测试的目的是参数化充分性：是否冻结 相应的传入跨度仍然允许低残留端点 描述。因为The reconstruction classes have different dimensions, so we do not interpret their residual ordering as a complexity-normalized model-selection result. The purpose of the test is parameterization sufficiency: whether freezing the corresponding incoming span still permits a low-residual endpoint description. Because𝒞mix\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{mix}}, 𝒞L\mathcal{C}_{L}, 和, and𝒞R\mathcal{C}_{R}比相关的固定频谱更宽松 限制，它们的残差是导致误差的乐观下限 通过冻结该框架结构。are more permissive than the associated fixed-spectrum restrictions, their residuals are optimistic lower bounds on the error caused by freezing that frame structure.

使得旋转仅作用于该层的输入（列）空间。每个 旋转通过凯莱逆变换映射到斜对称矩阵，so that the rotation acts only on the input (column) space of the layer. Each rotation is mapped to a skew-symmetric matrix by the inverse Cayley transform,

OrthoMerge 是最接近 ISO-Merger 的几何感知基线，但是两者 方法作用于不同的坐标。 OrthoMerge 应用了单方面的 每个矩阵输入端的正交变换：OrthoMerge is the geometry-aware baseline closest to ISO-Merger, but the two methods act in different coordinates. OrthoMerge applies a one-sided orthogonal transformation on the input side of each matrix:W0(ℓ)​RW_{0}^{(\ell)}R保留左奇异方向和奇异值preserves the left singular directions and singular values ofW0(ℓ)W_{0}^{(\ell)}，因此任何输出端帧的变化都必须通过 其欧几里得残差路径。, so any output-side frame change must be represented through its Euclidean residual path.

ISO-Merger 相反，在共享基础下组合两侧框架更改 频谱，适应两者ISO-Merger instead composes two-sided frame changes under the shared base spectrum, adapting bothUU和andVV在固定谱斯蒂菲尔坐标中。 OrthoMerge 的旋转类包含在更宽松的 输出子空间保留类in fixed-spectrum Stiefel coordinates. OrthoMerge’s rotation class is contained in the more permissive output-subspace-retaining class𝒞L\mathcal{C}_{L}分析于 部分analyzed in Section3。即使是这个较大的班级也留下了大量的 无法解释的更新比率，同时保留传入频谱 调整两个框架给出了低残差描述。这激励 ISO-Merger 的两侧框架参数化。. Even this larger class leaves a substantial unexplained-update ratio, whereas retaining the incoming spectrum while adapting both frames gives a low-residual description. This motivates ISO-Merger’s two-sided frame parameterization.

评估协议。Evaluation protocol.

对于Qwen2.5设置，我们在LiveBench和LiveCodeBench上评估编码， BFCL 上的工具使用，以及 RULER HotpotQA 和 SQuAD 上的长上下文记忆 32K–64K 上下文长度。对于 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 设置，我们评估 在 LiveBench 和 LiveCodeBench 上进行编码，在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC23 上进行数学计算， 密涅瓦和奥林匹克长凳。除非另有说明，我们生成 16 个首次展示 根据提示并报告三次独立运行的平均值和标准差。For the Qwen2.5 setting, we evaluate coding on LiveBench and LiveCodeBench, tool use on BFCL, and long-context memory on RULER HotpotQA and SQuAD at 32K–64K context lengths. For the DeepSeek-R1-Distill setting, we evaluate coding on LiveBench and LiveCodeBench, and math on AIME24, AIME25, AMC23, Minerva, and OlympiadBench.
